title: Oozy Mediterranean Cheese Tagine
description: A cultured and gooey Mediterranean dish featuring liquid cheese, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this tagine-cooked meal is macrobiotic-friendly and delicious.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced halloumi cheese and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Add the chopped sun dried tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and kalamata olives to the tagine.
Sprinkle the tagine spice blend over the top of the cheese and vegetables.
Pour the lemon juice over the top of the tagine.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the vegetables are tender.
